links.passage: The Hydro-Tech system was tested in commercial farms resulting in 5–20 % reductions of applied water (Todorovic et al., 2016).
supporting_passages: The Hydro-Tech (Todorovic et al., 2016) is a cloud-based application for automatic real-time irrigation scheduling based on the water balance.
The FAO56 approach for the estimation of ETc using real time or forecast weather is combined with continuous soil water content monitoring and remote control of the water supply network.
The Hydro-Tech system was tested in commercial farms resulting in 5–20 % reductions of applied water (Todorovic et al., 2016).
links.inference_note: The preceding sentences define Hydro-Tech as a cloud-based automatic real-time irrigation scheduling application (using soil water monitoring as input), and the cited sentence reports that this scheduling system reduced applied water by 5–20 % on commercial farms.

links.passage: Testing on commercial farms showed that GesCoN reduced water and N use, and enabled appreciable financial savings (Elia et al., 2020a, b; Antonio Elia, University of Foggia, personal communication).
supporting_passages: The GesCoN DSS has been recently developed at the University of Foggia (Italy) to help improve N management of fertigated, open field vegetable crops (Elia and Conversa, 2015).
The DSS provides daily recommendations of irrigation and N fertilizer requirements.
The GesCoN DSS has been incorporated into the Ecofert platform to enhance access and its practical use. User access is through a web-application (www.ecofert.it) and an Android App (Ecofert).
Testing on commercial farms showed that GesCoN reduced water and N use, and enabled appreciable financial savings (Elia et al., 2020a, b; Antonio Elia, University of Foggia, personal communication).
links.inference_note: Earlier sentences establish GesCoN as a decision-support system delivering daily irrigation recommendations via a web application and Android App, and the cited sentence states that its use on commercial farms reduced water use.
